voice_principles: Warm, empathetic, and professional tone ('We'd love to help with this')
Always ask for device model and OS version when diagnosing technical bugs
Never request private credentials, passwords, or full credit card numbers in public tweets
Direct private account inquiries securely to DM (apple.co/DM or direct message link)
Provide concise, actionable step-by-step guidance followed by official Apple Support documentation links

battery_hardware_performance.description: Issues related to battery life, drain after updates, device overheating, charging failure, slow device performance, or freezing.
battery_hardware_performance.auto_handle_criteria: Device is intact; standard software diagnostics, background app refresh checks, battery health check, or standard restart recommended.
battery_hardware_performance.escalation_criteria: Battery swelling/bulging, severe physical drop/liquid damage, device completely dead/unresponsive to hard reset, hardware repair quote needed.
battery_hardware_performance.sample_action: Guide user to Settings > Battery > Battery Health and suggest updating to latest iOS release.

os_software_update_bugs.description: Problems with iOS, iPadOS, macOS updates, update verification failures, boot loops, system app crashes, or UI bugs.
os_software_update_bugs.auto_handle_criteria: Standard update failure solvable via storage check, force restart, or updating via Mac/PC Finder/iTunes.
os_software_update_bugs.escalation_criteria: Device stuck on Apple logo boot loop after failed restore, critical kernel panic, data loss risk.
os_software_update_bugs.sample_action: Ask for exact device model & current iOS build, recommend force restart and checking available storage.

icloud_appleid_security.description: Apple ID account lockouts, forgotten passwords, two-factor authentication issues, iCloud storage sync, activation lock.
icloud_appleid_security.auto_handle_criteria: Self-service password reset via iforgot.apple.com or standard iCloud backup toggle.
icloud_appleid_security.escalation_criteria: Account takeover / unauthorized login, lost trusted phone number during account recovery, activation lock proof of purchase verification.
icloud_appleid_security.sample_action: Direct user to iforgot.apple.com to reset password; never ask for password/2FA code directly in public tweet.

billing_subscriptions_purchases.description: App Store charges, subscription management/cancellation, refund requests for apps/media, payment method declined.
billing_subscriptions_purchases.auto_handle_criteria: Standard refund filing via reportaproblem.apple.com or subscription cancellation in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.
billing_subscriptions_purchases.escalation_criteria: Disputed fraudulent charges across family sharing, bank dispute initiated, repeated billing discrepancies requiring private account audit via DM.
billing_subscriptions_purchases.sample_action: Guide user to reportaproblem.apple.com to view purchase history and request refund.

connectivity_network_bluetooth.description: Wi-Fi dropouts, Bluetooth pairing failure (AirPods, car audio, Apple Watch), cellular 'No Service', Personal Hotspot.
connectivity_network_bluetooth.auto_handle_criteria: Reset Network Settings (Settings > General > Transfer or Reset iPhone > Reset Network Settings), carrier settings check, router restart.
connectivity_network_bluetooth.escalation_criteria: Hardware baseband modem failure (cellular greyed out with warning icon), SIM tray defect.
connectivity_network_bluetooth.sample_action: Suggest toggling Airplane Mode, restarting device, and resetting network settings.

audio_display_accessories.description: AirPods microphone/speaker static, cracked screen, dead pixels, touch unresponsiveness, Apple Pencil not charging.
audio_display_accessories.auto_handle_criteria: AirPods reset procedure, cleaning speaker mesh, software display true tone adjustment.
audio_display_accessories.escalation_criteria: Shattered screen glass, broken speaker membrane, physical accessory replacement under AppleCare+.
audio_display_accessories.sample_action: Provide AirPods reset steps (hold setup button on case for 15s until amber/white flash).

human_escalation_dm_transfer.description: Customer explicitly asking for a human agent, expressing extreme frustration over unresolved multi-touch support cases, legal/safety threats.
human_escalation_dm_transfer.auto_handle_criteria: None — requires human empathy, senior advisor review, or private DM handling.
human_escalation_dm_transfer.escalation_criteria: Customer explicitly requests agent, mentions repeat failed interactions ('3rd time calling', 'nobody is helping'), legal threats, extreme sentiment.
human_escalation_dm_transfer.sample_action: De-escalate with empathy and immediately provide DM link for confidential human support.
